thread:
Priya: Quick async check — we need to lock owners and clear blockers for the Console observability pieces before the end-of-month milestone. My suggested split: dashboards -> Ari + Megan, tracing hooks -> Carlos + infra, error-analysis views -> Priya + DataEng. Any objections?

Ari: fine on dashboards. I'll own panel templates and perf knobs. estimate: finish panel templates by 2026-03-25. Need the span tag list from tracing to wire alerts. :eyes:﻿

Megan: happy to help UX and filters. FYI need the schema for the error payload so the columns match. @Priya can you drop a link to proto or example?

Carlos: tracing hooks look doable but there's an agent change + ingest pipeline schema change. I'll open an agent PR today for header propagation. deps: eng-runtime needs a small header passthrough change (header name x-rdwd-span).

Sam (infra): header passthrough is fine, but routing change needs a short maintenance window. We have a 2-hour quiet window on Sundays, or we can do rolling if you can tolerate duplicate spans for ~30m. Which do you prefer?

Priya: Let's aim for non-disruptive rolling if possible. If infra wants full quiet window, pick Sunday 03:00 UTC next week. Otherwise do rolling and monitor. Target milestone date is 2026-03-31; if infra needs two weeks we'll canary tracing in week 2.

Carlos: rolling + canary sounds good. I'll mark the agent PR WIP and add a canary flag. Will include a tiny config snippet: 

```yaml
tracing:
  enabled: true
  header: "x-rdwd-span"
  canary_percent: 10
```

Megan: re: error-analysis views — Priya, can we reuse the existing errors index + an extra grouping by model_id? If yes I can sketch queries tomorrow.

Priya: yes reuse is preferred. Please add a small eval query set so Optimize can detect regressions.

Ari: heads-up — dashboards depend on a small change in telemetry retention (traces need 7d -> 14d for cross-request linking). Who owns retention config? @Sam (infra)?

Sam (infra): retention config is infra-owned but we need product approval for cost tradeoff. Send a short cost estimate and I'll queue the change.

Priya: I'll draft a cost + ROI blurb by EOD and ping finance if needed.

Carlos: PR for agent side opened: https://git.redwood/trace-agent/pulls/342 — includes header passthrough + canary flag. @Sam (infra) can you review ownership of the deploy play?

Sam (infra): will review. Please add a rollback knob in the deploy notes.

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR 342 — integration tests ok, staging deploy scheduled. :rocket:﻿

Megan: quick QA question — what dashboard rows should be linked to the error-analysis view? stacktrace, model_id, request_path?

Priya: stacktrace + model_id are primary, include request_path as optional. We'll iterate after first canary.

Ari: I'll create the dashboard skeleton and tag owners. Expect a draft by Monday.

Carlos: pinging eng-ml for span tag conventions — @Megan can you add a short note in the PR about expected tags (model_id, model_version, request_id)?

Megan: done, added a comment in PR 342.

Priya: thanks all. Action items: Carlos — finish PR and add canary config; Ari + Megan — dashboard skeleton + queries; Sam — plan deploy & retention estimate; Priya — cost blurb + coordinate DataEng. We'll reconvene if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
